entities.name: Ishikari Bindra
entities.description: An inventor and aether specialist from Avishkar who created the Aetherspark and died doing so.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: An artificial planeswalker's spark device created by Ishikari Bindra from a piece of the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: Inventor of the Planar Bridge, whose writings obsessed Ishikari; he dismissed her idea.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Used by Phyrexians to breach the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who breached the Blind Eternities during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Phyrexians breached the Blind Eternities with Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, a piece of which Ishikari grabbed.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: An interplanar competition whose second running had the Aetherspark as prize.

events.summary: Ishikari fixates on creating an artificial spark; her professors and Rashmi dismiss the idea.
events.quote: Ishikari fixated on creating an artificial planeswalker's spark to make interplanar travel possible for common people.

events.summary: Ishikari builds her machine and grabs a piece of the Blind Eternities, creating the Aetherspark, but dies.
events.quote: Although she successfully grabbed a piece of the Blind Eternities to create the Aetherspark , she died in the process.

events.summary: The Aetherspark becomes the prize in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: the Aetherspark was the prize in the second interplanar Ghirapur Grand Prix

relations.note: She created it from a piece of the Blind Eternities
relations.quote: Ishikari Bindra was an inventor and aether specialist from Avishkar , and the creator of the Aetherspark .
